Deals 160% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to reduce their SPD by 20% for 2 turns.

ShelterPassiveExclusive Lv.1
Increases Shielded Effect by 20%. Grants self a [Shield] by 20% of Max HP for 1 turn when a turn ends.

TardinessActiveExclusive Lv.3
Increases all allies' SPD by 20% for 2 turns. Afterward, self gains 1 more action turn.
